PC-1 · Operator field guide

Operator’s Pocket Card

A one-page field reference for the five-field brief, six-beat ritual, evidence standard, and stop conditions.

Use whenKeep beside the keyboard during any evidence-bearing AI run.
Working time5 min
Leave withA printed one-page operator card.

Course connection. Keep Operator pulse open for the live course path and current tool details.

On this page

  1. Brief first; stop on signal

Brief first; stop on signal

Keep this beside the keyboard during evidence-bearing work. Plan about five minutes. Open the full Direction Brief whenever a cue is unclear.

Two independent lists share this table: read down the brief pair at left and the load/response pair at right, not across rows.
Brief fieldRetrieval cueLoad signalOperator move
1 · OutcomeArtifact or state; not activity.Mission changes materially.Hand back. Record the redirect; supersede and rebrief when needed.
2 · Done looks likeObservable open, run, compare, or count checks.Verdict requested; proof missing.Inspect the artifact and point to a path, test, citation, or rerun in the Log. No proof: gather it or assign REJECT / ACCEPT WITH FIXES.
3 · BoundsForbidden paths, tools, data, actions, and scope.Bound, “ask before,” scope, or authority crossing.Stop and return the crossing. Resume only after your explicit decision and revised brief.
4 · Evidence standardProof for ACCEPT; never model self-assessment.Adversarial attack lands.Fix or change the log/bars. Copy the line from the frozen review; measure only after it.
5 · Stop / hand-backFailure modes, time box, or “ask before X.”Named stop signal arrives.Return control with the exact signal. Record the stop; resume only after your explicit decision.

RUN GATE: You accept all five fields and mark the brief LIVE before the build chat. EVIDENCE BAR: “Looked good,” agreement, praise, confidence, and model self-assessment do not earn ACCEPT.

A concrete-evidence REJECT is successful operation. After measurement, update Transfer 30-60-90. Open the exact pulse rhythm and time boxes when needed.
